findings.title: Sade Sati phase walker collapses on Saturn's retrograde re-entry
Sade Sati verdict hardcodes the reading its cited source refutes
Vedha rules transcribed correctly, then tagged as KP by the book that rejects them
Transit star lord and sub lord have swapped roles in get_transit_analysis
Sade Sati intensity multipliers are unsourced and keyed to planet identity
The engine cites two source trees and neither exists
Transit timing opens a window on star OR sub, where the corpus requires both
Lagna minute-prediction gates on the sub lord alone and never reads the star lord
The weather compactor claimed any response with a top-level windows array, and reduced get_sade_sati_intensity to 19 characters
An electional event was named from a misread heading, so partnership meetings elected on scholarship-letter houses
A natal retrograde star lord was treated as denial, where KP treats it as delay
The timing cascade advertises a Lagna tier it does not implement
Triple confirmation checks star and sub but never the sign
The KP ayanamsa was 85 arcminutes wrong, so 78% of all sub lords were one position off
The test suite mostly asserts that code ran, not that it is right
The litigation verdict computed the sixth house, printed it, and then left it out of the comparison
"'Legal Disputes / Court' is an occurrence gate that reads like an outcome gate, and puts the opponent's house on the required side"
Ashtama Sani came back as a bare date range, which is the exact output four Reader 5 chapters exist to reject
The progeny denial group was missing the 10th, and the adoption rule was filed under miscarriage
Punarphoo has a Reader 4 chapter to itself as a marriage rule, and the engine computed it only inside the electional scan
The Porutham rejection was right and almost every fact in it was wrong, and the six points KSK substitutes were missing
Mars Dosha used one reference point of three and counted houses where the corpus says signs
KSK's replacement for Mars Dosha is implemented, and its raw form fires on 100% of charts
The engine could say whether marriage is promised and when, and nothing about why it is late
The spouse description was read from a planet the corpus never names, on the authority of a file that does not exist
The four-level order is corpus-confirmed, its conditional on L2 and L4 is now settled and implemented, and the two uncited weight tables are unified
bunfig.toml set a 30s test timeout, bun test ignored it silently, and CI has been running at 5s
The querent's horary number is computed, reported, and then discarded. It never reaches the chart.
The level weight table is declared 23 times, and the file that says it is the only one is wrong
The ruling-planet role ladder invents weights and silently picks one of three corpus orders
Thirteen definitions of STRONG, five scales, one vocabulary, and KP has no number at all
The hospitalization house group carried the cure house and dropped the body
A sign-occupancy panel and an uncodified transplant method were both tagged kp
The cure window timed a cure without ever asking whether there is one
The cuspal sub lord verdict was gated on dignity, retrogression and combustion, which KP discards by name
get_aspects_and_strength ships Parashari graha drishti and a Parashari strength score, tagged kp, in the foundation group
The Four Step Theory was credited to Hariharan on four surfaces; it is Sunil Gondhalekar's
The MCP compactor deleted 92% of the promise response, including every reason for the verdict
The promise verdict denied on ONE denial house, on a rule no corpus page states
Chronic Illness carried the body house in its denial group and an electional cure set as its negation
The event resolver matched inside a word, so "employment" resolved to Unemployment
career_possible was decided by the obstruction houses and never read the career houses it computed
Horary retrograde rules were gating natal career promises in two tools
Job Loss / Termination carried the general loss triad, not the end-of-service group
normalize360 was not the identity for in-range values, and KP decides on boundaries
Ashtakavarga is computed in houses and read as signs, so 93.6% of its sign scores are wrong
Shadbala ships the six classical names over six invented 0-100 scores, and one of them is inverted
Vimsopaka drops two of the sixteen vargas and scores the rest on an invented dignity ladder
Kemadruma is structurally unreportable, its cancellation fires on 100% of charts that reach it
Chara dasha runs zodiacally for every chart, and the karaka scheme calls a live dispute "the authentic method"
Two of fifteen saham formulas are attested, one of those disagrees with the engine, and Yasas admits its own substitution
Parivartana is classified by the houses the planets occupy, where Phaladeepika classifies by the houses they own
Graha yuddha names the winner by dignity and lower longitude, where Brihat Samhita names it by latitude
Kalsarpa ships as a Severe dosha with named remedies, and no classical text contains it
The weather family blends three traditions under one absent citation and ships all four tools tagged kp
The weather verdict's rain and drought house sets match no stated convention, and put the 6th on the dry side
The coverage ladder issued DENIED on an invented threshold, for a cuspal sub lord that does reach the required group
Business Start read two cusps and took the weaker, where KSK names the 7th cusp sub lord and the houses 2, 7 and 10
The star-lord denial route is the cuspal sub lord's own significations counted twice, and where it is not, it reaches two stellar hops above the cusp
The oncology promise is gated on an invented star-lord "cure bias", and the comment says so
KP states a grammar for building a denial group, and 71 of the 78 event rows do not follow it
The nakshatra was recomputed from the longitude instead of read off the row, and contradicted its own star lord on 9 of the 249 horary numbers
"\"Stationary\" was an invented state with three incompatible definitions, and the question KP actually asks, when does the planet turn direct, had no answer at all"
Every audit script subtracted the UTC offset twice, so the 48-chart spread was never the spread it named

questions.title: Is a natal retrograde star lord a DENIAL, or only a delay?
Where does the Saturn / Jupiter / Sun / Moon tier structure come from?
Lagna transit: "Constellation or sub", or star and sub and sub-sub?
Is the Sade Sati benefic house set wider than 10 and 11?
What are KSK's own published ayanamsa values, year by year?
For each electional house group, what event does KP literature attach it to?
Horary "when will they arrive", and the progeny reading. Does the engine cover either properly?
Punarphoo: which houses must Saturn occupy? The corpus sentence has its numbers missing.
KSK replaces Mars Dosha with a sub-lord test. Which houses does it name?
Do occupants and owners stop signifying a house when their own star is tenanted?
Must a ripe transit occupy the significator's SIGN as well as its star and sub?
Does KP assign a number to anything, or is every score in this engine an invention?
Is there a medical KP, and is this engine's health surface actually it?
Does ONE denial house deny a matter, or does the whole denial group have to be signified?
What is the KP method for profession, and how much of this engine's career surface is it?
Exactly how does a KP horary number become a chart, and what does the number fix?
Where is chapter and verse for the 53 tools whose tradition is not in the corpus?
Is there a KP weather method, and whose is the one this engine ships?
What does KP FORBID, and what does it discard from Parashari?
When the cuspal sub lord's STAR LORD signifies a denial house, is that a different verdict from the sub lord doing it?
For the events KSK does not state a house group for, what do the KP successors state, and which variant is most attested?
What are the Tajika saham formulas as *Tajika Neelakanthi* states them, and which of the engine's fifteen match?
